chunks: He who turns his face to God in submission and does good, holds fast to a handle that is strong; for the resultance of things rests with God.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to hold fast to the strongest handle in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as defining the perfect state of faith where outward submission (Islam) is perfected by inward sincerity and good deeds (Ihsan), thereby securing the believer to the unbreakable bond of divine guidance. The phrase 'Al-'Urwa Al-Wuthqa' is frequently linked to the Ahl al-Bayt or the Quran itself as the tangible means of holding fast, while the concluding clause reminds the faithful that ultimate success and resolution of all matters rest solely with Allah.
